mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, indicates a growing demand for housing and construction, which in turn drives economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, below 1.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy that stimulates economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, below 4.5% indicates a strong labor market, which in turn drives consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, indicates a growing supply of goods and services, which in turn drives economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales, as measured by RSAFS, indicates a growing demand for consumer goods, which in turn drives economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces economic growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, above 5.5% indicates a weak labor market, which in turn reduces consumer spending and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP, as measured by GDPC1, and a low unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, indicate a growing demand for goods and services and a strong labor market, which in turn drive economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).
